stories.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI stopped developing a new AI model called Astra because it became smart enough to find and carry out cyberattacks on computer systems by itself. The company decided it was too dangerous to keep working on it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to technology companies and security experts — nothing you need to act on. It shows responsible companies will pump the brakes when AI becomes risky.

stories.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
stories.simple_summary: A software company called Rippling wasted a lot of money using AI tools without tracking the costs. Now they built a new tool to help businesses see exactly how much their employees are spending on AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI tools in your business, this kind of tracking tool could help you understand whether you're getting good value for your money.

stories.title: ‘SaaSpocalypse’ debate intensifies as software stocks swing wildly
stories.simple_summary: Stock prices for software companies are going up and down wildly right now, and people are worried about the future of this industry.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own stock in software companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
stories.simple_summary: A rapper used an AI tool to create a song, and now he's admitting that AI helped make the music instead of him writing and performing it all himself.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect your business or daily life — it's mainly interesting to musicians and entertainment fans who care about what's authentic.

stories.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
stories.simple_summary: Roku (a TV streaming service) created a new channel that only shows movies and videos made by AI, rather than traditional entertainment made by real filmmakers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you watch Roku for entertainment, you now have the option to watch AI-made content, but there are plenty of other channels with real films and shows too.

stories.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI paused work on a new AI model called Astra because it's not safe enough yet — it can act on its own in dangerous ways without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to technology companies and security experts — nothing you need to act on. It shows the company is being careful about safety.

stories.title: What’s behind the Google AI shake-up
stories.simple_summary: Several important AI researchers, including a famous Google scientist named Jeff Dean, left Google or changed jobs this week.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who follow the AI industry — it could signal that Google is losing talent to competitors, but it doesn't affect everyday people.

stories.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
stories.simple_summary: A company called Cloudflare built a special internet browser designed just for AI robots (not people) to use when they're automating tasks on websites.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical tool for software developers — nothing you need to worry about as a regular user or small-business owner.

stories.title: Opinion | Don't Anthropomorphize Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: An opinion article warns people not to think of AI as having human-like feelings or intentions.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a helpful reminder to think clearly about AI — it's a tool, not a being with thoughts, even if it seems smart.

stories.title: AI used to create synthetic virus
stories.simple_summary: Researchers used AI to help design a virus, and this is being reported as a concern.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious topic for scientists and security experts to debate — it doesn't affect you directly, but it highlights why AI needs careful oversight.

stories.title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
stories.simple_summary: Airbnb is using AI to build new features for searching and booking rentals faster than before.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Airbnb to find places to stay, you may eventually see a slightly better search experience, but nothing major is changing.

stories.title: Jill Lepore on the ‘Artificial State’ and why Silicon Valley’s leaders are bad sci-fi readers
stories.simple_summary: A historian is writing a book about how technology company leaders often use grand, government-like language to describe their products in ways that don't match reality.
stories.why_it_matters: This is commentary for people interested in how tech companies talk about themselves — nothing you need to act on.
